'''Dust Squadron''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] led by [[Rik Torrence]] and stationed at [[Arda Base]]. It was in operation by the time of the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], but was reserved for key missions in the sector. The squadron fought in the Battle of the Gauntlet.

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dust Squadron appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''.
